images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a brand-new original painted illustration of a different dragon individual for a Dragon Database hover card. This is NOT an edit or recoloring of any existing dragon. Style: sophisticated colorful epic fantasy storybook illustration, richly brushed gouache and watercolor with delicate ink-like scale details and tactile painted texture, mature powerful creature, luminous atmospheric depth; not a photograph, 3D render, childish cartoon or existing franchise character. Landscape about 5:3, full bleed, single clear central dragon dominates 65–80% of the frame, detailed expressive face and crisp silhouette, strong light/dark and warm/cool separation against a quieter softly painted but recognizable epic setting. New character design, horn shape, proportions, body markings, pose and entire scene. Leave room around important anatomy, horns, feet, wings and tail within the frame so it reads well on a small card. No text, labels, signatures, border, watermark, extra dragons, people or gore. Entirely new individual: a muscular PEARL-IVORY and GOLD classic dragon with sapphire-blue wing membranes, broad short blunt muzzle, thick neck, stocky powerful shoulders, short forward-curving forked antler horns and natural dark blue scale markings. Exactly FOUR clawed legs and TWO distinct membranous wings, long thick tail. It is walking toward the LEFT in a low powerful guardian stride, wings half unfurled and both visible, mouth slightly open in a warning growl, no fire. Entirely new scene: inside a vast subterranean AMETHYST CRYSTAL cavern with inky violet shadow walls, glowing magenta and blue crystal pillars and a quiet shallow reflective pool beneath obsidian arches. Subject pearl scales catch pale gold light and stand sharply out against the dark purple grotto. Calm grand cave depth instead of a sky/cliff/castle landscape. This must NOT be a long-snouted indigo/purple dragon with red wings, upright on a dawn overlook. Strong mature head design and new low walking silhouette, four feet naturally separated.
